description: Checkpoints (section 5.3): restated writes, null and cleared, overlap, permanent delete.

vectors.name: checkpoint/fold-on-top
vectors.description: A checkpoint restates the winning writes of four records; then a later edit, a record with an older clock (loses to the checkpointed winner) and an edit of a deleted item (revives it). Run 0 folds the checkpoint and the three later records, run 1 folds all seven records and no checkpoint, run 2 folds both: all three give one state except that history before the checkpoint exists only without it.

vectors.name: checkpoint/null-versus-cleared
vectors.description: A field set to the value null and a cleared field give different checkpoint payloads ([1, clock, null] against [0, clock]) and different states after folding them.

vectors.name: checkpoint/null-then-later-set
vectors.description: A cleared field restated by a checkpoint still loses to a later set, and a later clear still beats a restated null.

vectors.name: checkpoint/overlapping-both-orders
vectors.description: Two checkpoints that overlap (the first restates records 0 to 2, the second records 1 to 3) folded in both orders, alone and on top of the records, all give the state of the four records.

vectors.name: checkpoint/purged
vectors.description: purged names an item and a place in the order: every write of that item up to that place is forgotten, in the checkpoint, in the records still held and in records folded later; a write after it survives. Run 0: the checkpoint alone; run 1: with the records.

vectors.name: checkpoint/purged-everything
vectors.description: purged up to the item's last write removes the item altogether.

vectors.name: checkpoint/purged-two-places
vectors.description: Two purged entries for one item: the later place applies.
